rule_description: Pin versions in pip. Instead of `pip install <package>` use `pip install <package>==<version>` or `pip install --requirement <requirements file>`

FROM pytorch/pytorch:2.0.1-cuda11.7-cudnn8-runtime

WORKDIR /pipeline

COPY requirements.txt .
COPY *.py ./

# Install the pipeline requirements and check that there are no conflicts.
# Since the image already has all the dependencies installed,
# there's no need to run with the --requirements_file option.
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && pip check

# Set the entrypoint to Apache Beam SDK worker launcher.
COPY --from=apache/beam_python3.14_sdk:2.73.0 /opt/apache/beam /opt/apache/beam
ENTRYPOINT [ "/opt/apache/beam/boot" ]
